name: You've Been Drafted!
desc:
The army is at your door. You've been drafted, straight off your couch and into boot camp!

🚚 Ride the army truck to camp
💈 Get your hair buzzed off in public
🫡 Obey Sergeant Stone in the drill... or do push-ups
🌳 Tiptoe across a wobbly tree branch
🪂 Zipline down into the valley
🔥 Toast marshmallows at the campfire
🪖 Crawl under the barbed wire at dawn
🎖️ Graduate and get your new job!

⭐ 14 jobs to collect, from Latrine Scrubber to Space Force Astronaut
🚀 Ride home in a truck, a jet, a rocket... or on a goat
🏅 Rank up from Recruit to General

⏩ In a hurry? Skip the line or the wait
📣 Or become the Drill Sergeant and boss everyone around

What job will YOU get? 👀
